objective: Connect observed and scenario generation pathways to technical, health, regulatory, and sustainability consequences without overstating causality or precision.
default_story_sequence: How much energy and electricity is produced by each method?
What operating role and grid services does each method provide?
What technical constraints limit delivery at the required time and place?
What routine, upstream, accident, and distributional health pathways are supported?
Which legal status and permitting layers currently apply?
What lifecycle climate, water, land, materials, ecological, waste, and intergenerational burdens remain?
Which mitigations reduce which burden, what new burdens do they add, and what residual risks remain?
global_filters: resource versus carrier versus conversion versus storage

views.purpose: Show observed history and conditional futures through 2050-2100.
views.visual: small-multiple stacked areas or lines by model/scenario
rules: No model splicing into one unlabeled line
No U.S. extrapolation after 2050
No marine interpolation after its 2050 milestone
Scenarios are not forecasts

views.purpose: Prevent annual generation or capacity factor from masquerading as reliability.
views.visual: technology-by-service matrix plus regional time-series context
views.data_status: qualitative_framework_ready; quantitative regional service data pending

views.purpose: Show interconnection, planning, siting, and operating integration as separate stages.
views.visual: stage flow with queue and disturbance evidence
rules: Queued is not operating
A rule is not a built line
An event report is not a fleet failure rate

views.purpose: Trace supported causal steps and attribution limits.
views.visual: pathway diagram plus pollutant and evidence panels
rules: No death inference from generation alone
No causal inference from proximity alone
WHO all-source deaths are not power-sector deaths
Separate routine and accident evidence

views.purpose: Represent changing legal status without converting proposals or deadline changes into final substantive outcomes.
rules: Every card has as-of date
Proposed is visually distinct from final
Compliance date is separate from requirement
Federal context is not a complete local permit list

views.purpose: Compare broad lifecycle emissions while preserving uncertainty and vintage.
views.visual: median and range plot; consider log axis
rules: Show source year 2014
Medians never appear without ranges
Do not use as current plant measurements
Biomass requires separate land and counterfactual context
Hydro upper tail remains visible

views.purpose: Connect thermal generation and hydrology to the future water module.
views.visual: separate withdrawal and consumption panels by plant cooling type and basin
rules: Withdrawal and consumption never share one value
Do not assign the national thermoelectric total to one fuel
Show cooling system, basin, and year

views.purpose: Show supply-chain exposure and distinguish recyclable from recycled.
rules: Material-specific data only
Technical recyclability is not collection rate
Recycling does not eliminate primary mining
Uranium resources are not fabricated-fuel availability

views.purpose: Contextualize each generation method with benefits, problems, mitigation, residual risk, and evidence.
rules: No single good/bad badge
Unknown is not zero
Site and configuration qualifiers remain visible

views.purpose: Represent nuclear generation without either promotional or catastrophizing shortcuts.
views.visual: observed metrics, history/scenarios, fleet aging, stage-gated pipeline, health evidence, water, fuel, and waste chain
rules: Show NRC/EIA count conflict
Capacity factor is not safety or cost
Part 53 is not deployment
Zero-power criticality is not generation
Interim storage is not disposal
Show direct and indirect Fukushima findings together

impact_linkage_contract.purpose: Attach impacts to time-dependent generation pathways without pretending coefficients are universal.
impact_linkage_contract.reason: The present corpus supports qualitative pathways and selected benchmark ranges, but not a harmonized mortality, land, water, mineral, waste, cost, or reliability coefficient for every technology and year.

prohibited_patterns: single unlabeled clean-energy category that hides nuclear versus renewable composition
single technology score without published weights and sensitivity
capacity and generation on an unlabeled common axis
queue capacity styled as operating capacity
health deaths inferred from proximity or generation alone
operational emissions presented as lifecycle emissions
technical recyclability presented as actual recycling
test milestone presented as commercial nuclear generation
